title.narrative: Tertiary Education, Science, and Technology Project (TEST)

description.narrative: The objective of the Tertiary Education, Science, and Technology Project is to increase the number and quality of graduates with labor market-aligned skills in strategic priority areas. There are three components to the project, the first component being to improve the quality of incoming students in higher education. This component includes two subcomponents: expanding access to high quality pre-service teacher training and enhanced quality of instruction and teacher preparation programs. The second component is the improvement of the quality of programs in strategic priority areas. This component includes four subcomponents: strengthen quality assurance mechanisms, improve quality of instruction, equitable access, and industry relevance of programs in strategic priority areas, digitalize service delivery in higher education and build digital competency, and establish a National Research and Education Network (NREN) and upgrade university networks. Finally, the third component is the strengthened capacity in management, monitoring, and evaluation. The component will support investments in building the management capacity of HEIs and of MESCTI to strengthen the governance of the higher education system, planning, and monitoring, and evaluation activities in order to better coordinate the sector and hold actors accountable, including data collection, analysis and publication, evidence informed policymaking and sector progress monitoring toward sectoral targets, better budget execution, practical solutions on resources visibility and predictability, strengthened public FM and procurement, and improved budget transparency, through technical assistance, training and operating costs.
To improve equity and quality in higher education, expand teacher preparation programs, and strengthen the enabling environment for higher education.
